single_variable.name: catchup_value_loss
single_variable.treatment: SmoothL1 beta=1.0 raw critic-v1 bb unit

decision.scale_lock_rationale: beta=1.0 is the standard SmoothL1 canonical default and one raw critic-v1 unit equals one big blind; it is fixed without searching the forbidden holdout or H8 outcomes.
decision.rationale: H8 proves actor/trunk isolation and catch-up accounting while clearly refuting extra unweighted squared-error fitting as a calibration repair. A catch-up-only robust loss is the smallest upstream prospective change that limits outlier leverage without altering policy epochs, target-KL, targets, optimizer, actor/trunk, standard PPO critic loss or the positive internal mirror mechanism.
requirements: Separate immutable H9 preregistration, implementation audit, design lock, preflight and canonical watcher rearm before launch.
Fresh same-start control and treatment; no reuse of H8 endpoints as H9 outcomes.
Only catch-up loss differs; beta1.0 is frozen and no holdout-driven tuning is allowed.
Offline forced-trigger tests prove disabled-mode equivalence and actor/trunk/optimizer-state isolation.
Fixed endpoint calibration, KL, mirror, throughput, entropy and health gates; no extension, second seed or later endpoint.
No official Slumbot hands in H9.
